test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The citizens have chosen that man as their leader.

options.text: That man had been chosen by the citizens as their leader.
That man has been chosen by the citizens as their leader.
That man is chosen by the citizens as their leader.
That man was chosen by the citizens as their leader.

solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'That man has been chosen by the citizens as their leader.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **active voice**. We have to change the sentence into** passive form**. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'present perfect tense.'
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + have/has + V3 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + have/has + been + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Active voice: I have eaten the muskmelon.
 
• Passive voice: The muskmelon has been eaten by me. 
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The citizens' and the object of the given sentence is 'that man'. 
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• Also here, 'have chosen' will be changed into 'has been chosen'.
 
• The remaining part will be the same.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *That man has been chosen by the citizens as their leader.*
